replacements.description: One entry per flagged test: a replacement test, or why one is still not possible

replaces.description: Fully qualified name of the flagged test, as listed

test.description: The cheaper unit test that replaces it

name.description: Fully qualified test method name: Namespace.Class.Method

file.description: New test file you wrote, relative to the repository root

behavior.description: The observable behavior the test pins, in plain words; the same behavior the flagged test pins

find.description: Exact text that occurs once in the file

not_possible.description: When no cheaper test can reach the behavior even now; the flagged test stays

reason.description: Why a cheaper test is still not possible on the refactored code
